model_proof_basis: Actual --model argument recorded; JSONL result contains no model identifier. No model self-claim is treated as proof.

input.prefix: You are an adversarial architecture reviewer. Analyze only this shared public evidence and current baseline; do not use tools, memory, file operations or edit anything. Write a complete Korean critique with conclusion first, option A–D comparison (adopt/hold/reject, impact, pros/cons, correctness, security, context, host support, operational acceptance), rank proposals, identify weakest claims/unknowns, distinguish present implementation from unimplemented proposal, and provide clear counterarguments. Cite the supplied primary URLs/timestamps. Do not reveal hidden chain of thought. No fabricated experiment or inferred complete support.

final.extraction: Last completed agent_message text; preceding agent_message excluded as nonfinal preface.
final.normalization: Only a trailing newline added if absent; no substantive changes.

caveats: Requested model and xhigh effort are configured by the actual argv; native JSONL does not independently identify the served model or realized reasoning effort.

Identical frozen packet and complete stdin hashes are proven; identical complete native system/harness prompts across different CLIs are not proven. Normal CLI configuration loading was not bypassed or modified.
No model-originated tool invocation appears in returned native JSONL. The model was instructed not to use tools; read-only sandbox is not a network or reasoning-level enforcement guarantee.
mcp_servers={} was supplied exactly as required; no MCP tool-call events were observed. No claim is made that ordinary CLI configuration merge behavior independently proves an empty registry.
Token counts are native turn.completed usage, including harness overhead and cached input; not a packet-only token measurement.
Source audit statements and the critique are not implementation, performance, or native host Skills activation experiments.
No encrypted reasoning, hidden reasoning text, full raw events, authentication, or environment data is retained in deliverables.
